newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Consolidated Products estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Consolidated Products estimates cut.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Monday it lowered its estimate for Consolidated Products Inc's fiscal 1997 earnings to $0.99 per share from $1.10. It also lowered its fiscal 1998 estimate to $1.13 per share from $1.25.
-- Consolidated Products shares remain rated market outperformer for the intermediate and long term, EVEREN said.

-- EVEREN expects the company to open 32 company-owned Stake n Shake restaurants in fiscal 1997 and 10 franchised units. Consolidated Products operates restaurant chains, including Stake n Shake and Colorado Steakhouse.
-- EVEREN said the estimate adjustment followed Consolidated Products's recent announcement of its fifth 10-percent stock dividend in five years and was unrelated to the company's operations.
